scope: FR-01/FR-14 native-owned local startup, delayed readiness, launchd configuration and uninstall errors, scheduler notification failures; native archive retry and conversation restoration

launchd.boundaries: Real Settings and plist serialization in a temporary Path.home; all installation/uninstallation subprocess calls intercepted. No existing user service or LaunchAgents plist was touched.
checks: Generated plist uses the current interpreter, resolved agent.py, project working directory, data/output directories, captured PATH and separate output/error logs
RunAtLoad and KeepAlive are true; API Key name and synthetic Key value are absent from the plist
Bootstrap failure reaches CLI stderr with exit 1 and no installation success message
Uninstall targets the exact service label and removes its plist on success or ESRCH only
An absent service remains idempotent even when its plist still exists; an absent plist does not prevent stopping by service label
Permission denial, unknown errors and launchctl execution failure preserve the plist and return CLI failure; localized or misleading stderr is not used as the success predicate

absent_label_probe.authority: Installed launchctl(1) manual: service-target syntax and EXIT STATUS

scheduler_notification_failures.boundaries: Temporary SQLite; actual notification helper with intercepted osascript process failure or timeout; no system notification permission changed.
scheduler_notification_failures.verified: waiting_user, failed and missed records retain their reasons when notification delivery fails; waiting for paper material attempts the appropriate notification

native_ui_observations.observer: Root agent using CUA and accessibility; distinct from automated tests and this artifact writer's read-only process/database checks
checks_passed: Native self-launch connects without an externally started backend
PID 95051's controlled 75-second startup delay exceeds the 45-second initial deadline; the native UI later connects automatically without clicking reconnect
After archive failure and application restart, retry produces one archive document and one knowledge entry; preview shows finite graph traversal, a visited set and source messages 16/17
Restoring the conversation displays 这段对话已恢复。已保存1份归档文档，整理1条知识 and an available input field
Menu Quit exits the temporary native app; subsequent CUA inventory no longer lists it as running
native_ui_observations.swift_source_review: A live but unready native-owned backend keeps 10-second polling after the initial deadline; a ready probe hides the failure overlay and restores the connected state.

read_only_runtime_evidence.source: Temporary events.jsonl, known-PID ps checks, loopback status, and immutable read-only SQLite queries

older_python_initialization_observation.interpretation: Initialization was blocked at sampling time but this same PID later executed the backend; do not classify it as never having run. The intermittent delay cause remains unresolved.

limitations: No real launchd service installation, login launch or keepalive restart was exercised; service configuration and failure behavior use intercepted subprocesses, plus the never-registered-label probe.
Notification denial and timeout were injected; actual macOS notification permission was not revoked.
The 75-second delay was intentionally injected in the temporary backend and does not explain the separately observed intermittent Python initialization delay.
Synthetic model output validates native lifecycle, archive persistence and retry behavior, not model quality or external account integrations.
Actual system sleep/wake was not exercised.
